profile.name: 通用摄像头
profile.description: 通用可见光摄像头，可用于采集实验过程中的图像帧，适合样品观察、装置对准、过程监控和基础视觉记录等实验室场景。
profile.description_en: A general-purpose visible-light camera used to capture image frames in laboratory workflows, suitable for sample observation, instrument alignment, process monitoring, and basic visual recording.
